item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00420","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C20","C15","C18"],"selected_candidate_label":"C20","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C20 is the direct and materially reused template. The child expressly identifies the September 27, 1952 proclamation, carries forward its continuing Tariff Commission investigation and section 22 findings, and renews the same two-tier almond-fee machinery for the next annual period. The operative provision preserves the same covered almond products, 5-cent fee through 7,000,000 pounds, 10-cent fee thereafter, 50-percent-ad-valorem ceiling, and addition of the fees to other duties. C15 is an earlier almond-fee predecessor but differs materially in thresholds and structure; C18 closely parallels the findings language but concerns a filbert quota rather than the child's almond-fee mechanism.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"import fees on shelled almonds and blanched, roasted, or otherwise prepared or preserved almonds (not including almond paste) imposed pursuant to the President's proclamation of September 27, 1952","parent_excerpt":"a fee of 5 cents per pound shall be imposed upon shelled almonds and blanched, roasted, or otherwise prepared or preserved almonds (not including almond paste)","explanation":"The child expressly references C20 and renews its restriction on the identical product class."},{"child_excerpt":"a fee of 5 cents per pound, but not more than 50 per centum ad valorem ... until an aggregate quantity of 7,000,000 pounds ... and a fee of 10 cents per pound, but not more than 50 per centum ad valorem ... in excess","parent_excerpt":"a fee of 5 cents per pound ... until an aggregate quantity of 7,000,000 pounds ... and a fee of 10 cents per pound ... in excess of an aggregate quantity of 7,000,000 pounds: Provided, That in neither case shall the fee be in excess of 50 per centum ad valorem","explanation":"This is substantially the same distinctive two-tier fee formula, with only the annual dates and placement of the ad-valorem ceiling adjusted."},{"child_excerpt":"The said fees shall be in addition to any other duties imposed on the importation of such almonds.","parent_excerpt":"The fees imposed by this proclamation shall be in addition to any other duties imposed on the importation of the articles subject to such fees.","explanation":"The child closely carries over C20's supplementary-duty clause."},{"child_excerpt":"practically certain to be imported into the United States during the period October 1, 1953 to September 30, 1954 ... as to render or tend to render ineffective, or almonds","explanation":"The child advances C20's central finding by exactly one annual period while retaining its language and administrative predicate."}]}
